slices.name: Bounded native shape contract and shared property locator
changes: Typed recursive groups, 2D transforms, four primitive families, four paint kinds and all nine operator kinds.
Total 256 contents / 16-level tree, 16 gradient stops, stable unique sibling/stop IDs, and explicit animation/default descriptors.
Nested shape/gradient ID locator serves authored and sampled trees; opaque metadata remains inaccessible.
Pinned clipper2-ts 2.0.1-18 as renderer dependency for future Boolean/offset geometry. Native shape rendering stays feature-unavailable until its renderer slice.
Reject inherited/prototype field names in native selectors; shared default descriptors are immutable.
initialRepairs: Three JSON-boundary assertions expected comp-schema-type; newly strict shape discriminants correctly produce comp-schema-union. Depth/byte/cycle/UTF-8 assertions remain intact.
Two type-only schema locals failed unused-vars lint; remove the common schema local and export the reusable leaf schema.

slices.name: Native cubic math, primitives and rich morph correspondence
changes: Exact cubic extrema; fixed 0.25-unit flattening with depth 12 and explicit path/vertex/coordinate diagnostics.
Shared geometry budget API supports 262144 generated-point work / 4096 path work / ±1000000000 generated coordinates; native evaluator wiring follows the engine slice.
Cubic ellipse and rounded rect construction, polygon/star variants and clamped circular corner fillets. Polystar counts round to nearest integer at sampling.
Closed-path firstVertex rotates vertices and both tangent arrays before native sampling; open paths use 0.
Extend legacy PathMorphSchema to 1024 matched points, optional closed/tangent/alignment fields and actual rich rendering through native sampler/flattening; point-only arithmetic stays unchanged.
Evaluator and native renderer versions bumped; user/reference guidance documents alignment and corrects stale grouped-speed wording.
